# How to locate issues by layer when compiling legged_control / OCS2 for the first time?

> **Current answer:** Fix Ubuntu, ROS Noetic, Python, and the target release version, explicitly load the Workspace Environment Sourcing, compile and run the Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) or Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) example for OCS2; then add legged_controllers, Gazebo, and real machine hardware packages sequentially. Address missing dependencies for move_base_msgs, python3-catkin-tools, and empy, and use -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3 to fix the build interpreter. Avoid full recompilation repeatedly.
